location: San Miguel Street, fronting SM Mall, near Metrobank Santiago Branch, General Santos City, Philippines

title: Don Carmelo's Smokin' Area
description: Don Carmelo's Smokin' Area is a barbecue restaurant on Nunez Street in Purok Malakas, Barangay San Isidro, General Santos City. It offers smokehouse-style grilled meats, steaks, sausages, burritos, calzones, and other hearty dishes in a casual setting with outdoor seating. Frozen bacon is also available for takeout and may also be cooked and served for dine-in.
label: View restaurant guide
location: Nunez St., Purok Malakas, Bgy. San Isidro, General Santos City, Philippines, 9500
